_comment: Per-language SEA-HELM aggregate scores. The id score is the mean accuracy across the four tasks listed below (mean of per-task accuracy/norm_accuracy/overall_acc/criteria_score). jv and su are not supported by this SEA-HELM snapshot (it covers id, vi, ms, my, ta, th, tl only), so the capability_no_regression gate for jv/su is INCONCLUSIVE:SEA-HELM-cannot-measure-this. The base model run completed inference for all tasks but SEA-HELM's final aggregate_metrics() crashed at the PRAGMATICS step (KeyError 'subcategories', upstream bug, see logs/DEVIATIONS.md 2026-10-03). Per-task scores were recovered from results/seahelm_base/gemma2-9b-cpt-sahabatai-v1-instruct/run_0/results/*.json. tuned_tasks mirrors base_tasks and will be filled after Stage 5 with identical task list (rule 7).
